name: SOTOPIA
description: An open-ended environment to simulate complex social interactions between artificial agents for evaluating social intelligence, featuring role-play scenarios and a holistic evaluation framework called SOTOPIA-Eval.
reputation: SOTOPIA is a well-known recent benchmark for evaluating social intelligence in multi-agent role-play settings and is increasingly used in social-agent research.
notes: Includes a challenging subset called SOTOPIA-hard; shows GPT-4 underperforms humans on social commonsense reasoning and strategic communication.
